entries.8e889ed54d977a83: Under its mission “Tech Tomorrow,” its medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its final year, sets as its theme “growing into a Tech & Innovation Partner for client companies by leveraging its strengths in development capability and business creation capability.” As growth strategies, it says it will work on: continued growth of the App Business, including renewal of “APPBOX” into a next-generation platform premised on the use of generative AI technology; expansion into digital areas beyond app-related fields, leveraging its existing customer base, and provision of new DX services using generative AI; entry into the Business Produce domain centered on Qoil Co., Ltd.; creation and accelerated growth of new businesses such as the talent resource optimization platform “Co-Assign” and retail media; and strengthening partnerships with client companies, including expansion into joint business and revenue-share business models.
